rows.responsibility: Call recording and group-call control presentation: record state, add people, overflow, mute indicators, screen presentation, settings, and control-shadow decoration.
rows.upstream_owner: Telegram/SourceFiles/calls/calls.style and group call panel consumers for call_record*, calls_add_people, calls_more, calls_mute_*, calls_present, calls_settings, calls_shadow_controls
rows.state_machine: Group/active call state + media/recording/participant/device state -> controls/indicators -> canonical call actions; decorative shadow has no state ownership.
rows.side_effects: Present/screen-share and media settings change media state; add people mutates participants; recording controls recording lifecycle; mute indicators are derived.
rows.failure_cases: recording starts without consent/state owner; add-people duplicates call membership owner; screen sharing diverges from media state; settings create second device owner; mute indicator stale
rows.ui_disposition: Reuse HumanCallControls/CallSession and canonical Button/IconButton/Menu/Status; existing 1:1 mute/camera/screen-share is reusable. Add-people/group membership, call recording and group-call settings require extension of the same owners, not parallel Telegram components.
rows.fabushi_canonical_owner: HumanCallControls + CallSession for existing mute/camera/screen-share; canonical group-call membership/recording portions remain production gaps.
rows.platform_differences: Telegram raster scale variants/style compiler are source presentation. Fabushi Desktop uses canonical React/Electron controls, WebRTC media, Host CallSession and server transport; preserve behavior/state/a11y, not Telegram pixels.
rows.fabushi_target: SOURCE GAP IDENTIFIED: 1:1 media controls exist, but group participant mutation/recording/group-call product surface is not yet evidenced as shipping-complete.
